scope: Assessment of the uploaded Windows client, sanitized capture structure, launcher static findings, pinned public reference source and local Windows experiments.

launcher_evidence: RumbleLauncher.ini GENERAL/LAUNCHPARAM strings are referenced in launch setup.
Launcher contains /DIRECT: and process command formatting.
Launcher VersionURL/VersionFileURL and embedded CDN addresses concern updater metadata.
Static tracing establishes DIRECT suffix comes from Author literal plus updater TEMP/NUM, with no host/port lookup in this examined flow; see direct-launch-analysis.json.
limits: No actual text launcher INI demonstrating host/port configuration was available.
/DIRECT: is not evidence of an offline mode or server override.
Opaque rumfus.ini cannot presently be treated as editable text configuration.
Exposed strings in the protected client do not establish a supported endpoint option.
A server bind/listen address is not equivalent to configuring this client destination.

blockers.missing_evidence: A general configurable endpoint remains unknown; reversible loopback routing of the observed fixed destination is validated against the real client through a displayed login rejection. Additional services and full offline isolation remain unresolved.

facts: Uploaded client is x86.
Client imports d3dx9_42.dll and audiere.dll.
Launcher imports MSVCR100.dll.
Uploaded client manifest requests administrator execution.
Completed diagnostic found the checked adjacent x86 DirectX/audiere/MSVCR100 DLLs; both installed EXE hashes match uploaded bytes.
blockers.missing_evidence: Current client end-to-end execution against the original local backend; backend wire compatibility remains unvalidated.

facts: Observed client 0x0048/0x0080 totals 6 bytes.
Observed server 0x0048/0x0081 totals 68 bytes.
Pinned source SendGameGuard sends a fixed 84-byte response.
Observed later client 0x0048/0x0042 totals 116 bytes; pinned dispatcher has no matching action.
Local client log separately records a GameGuardResponse buffer of 108 bytes inside 110 body bytes.
Version1.4 real client requested clock after the synthetic local profile, then emitted the initial0x0048/0x0080 header; the probe intentionally stopped there.
Current initial response framing is header6 + LE16 opaque length60 + opaque60; reference framing uses length76. No original initializer generator is known.
Version1.5 wrote one captured68-byte initializer and then observed10/D0/total6, matching the original post-initialization sequence; no UI observation was supplied.
blockers.missing_evidence: A compatible fresh initializer generator and ongoing query/answer contract. One-frame replay produced the next startup header on the user Windows machine, but does not establish independent or ongoing authentication.

facts: Pinned source version handler acknowledges without inspecting request body, so acknowledgement is not version compatibility proof.
Credential parser and 326-byte success response layout are available as reference; the capture shares those total message sizes.
Pinned credential handler uses a local account database and bcrypt, generates token/GUID fields, and registers per-stream player state.
Pinned source contains raw request and token logging and a separate hardcoded-account login branch; do not use that branch as compatibility evidence.

A separate original C# probe has now received the real client login frame and sent a fixed rejection that the client displayed; later profile replies elicited clock and startup headers, while complete profile compatibility remains unverified.
Version1.4 synthetic profile reply produced subsequent clock and GameGuard headers; this is partial bootstrap progress, not complete profile/lobby validation.

Version1.5 reached the startup/status request10/D0. Version1.6 adds a fixed8-byte10/D1 acknowledgement and a synthetic18-byte31/89 reply with account1 and zero balances; Version1.6 subsequently wrote both replies and reached the property request.
Version1.6 wrote startup/status and local-balance replies then received30/84/total17. Screenshot shows FUNC_Q_GET_PROPERTY ... NULL; v1.6 intentionally omitted that response.
Version1.7 matched owner1, wrote one3928-byte empty property response, then received30/92/total6; screenshot displays FUNC_Q_GET_GIFT_FROM ... NULL. This is bounded empty-inventory progress.
Version1.8 wrote both3507-byte gift candidates; next buddy10/A8 header and FUNC_Q_GET_BUDDY_LIST NULL identify the current unsupported stage.
blockers.missing_evidence: Empty gift-list and remaining character/bootstrap contracts; populated inventory, avatar enumeration and gameplay remain unsupported. One empty property response elicited the next stage, not full inventory validation.
blockers.local_implementation: Original persistent local accounts, per-connection authentication, local tokens, avatar IDs and empty inventory/equipment replies now exist and pass synthetic loopback tests.

facts: Pinned PacketProcessor advances by 6 + length although observed header length includes the six-byte header.
It attempts to copy length bytes from offset + 6 and decrypts the full input inside a message loop.
blockers.interpretation: Static defects or assumptions require repair before treating this source as an executable current-client server; it was not run.

facts: Provided analyzed capture contains only one port-7000 session.
Prior logs include P2P/ProudManager indications.
blockers.missing_evidence: Training/lobby state flow and peer/service networking, including other previously observed ports outside this capture. No multiplayer compatibility is established.

diagnostic_artifacts.launch: Double-click CollectDiagnostics.cmd and choose the installation folder. Windows PowerShell and its existing execution policy are used; Python is not required.
diagnostic_artifacts.policy_block: If Windows policy blocks execution, preserve the error for review. The launcher does not alter or bypass execution policy.
diagnostic_artifacts.output_behavior: Writes a new JSON beside the script by default, refuses overwrite, and refuses a report destination inside the selected game directory.
collected: Exact known filename presence, size, SHA-256 and numeric version metadata.
Fixed-allowlist recognized INI key names and a count of unrecognized keys; all values and unknown key names excluded.
Fixed-allowlist candidate option names from already-running named game processes, with all values and raw command lines excluded.
Socket address classes, ports and TCP state for those processes, without literal addresses or process IDs.
diagnostic_artifacts.validation: Completed on user Windows PowerShell 5.1 after explicit output path was supplied. Exact installed client/launcher hashes match; adjacent checked runtime DLLs are present.
diagnostic_artifacts.limitations: Reports do not establish supported server-override semantics, binary config contents, GameGuard compatibility, or offline play.
